title: Ikea "Lamp" Commercial - Hi Res
summary: A Spike Jonze-directed Ikea commercial in which a discarded lamp is treated sympathetically, until a twist undercuts the sentiment. It is a short, well-known piece of advertising.
why: Used as the classic example of how easily humans anthropomorphize objects, brought up in AI and advertising threads.

quote.text: humans anthropomorphize things super easily, which IKEA exploited in this famous ad
